draft.summary: Export the weekly sales report to CSV
draft.description:
## Context
Proposed owner (from the meeting): Andrés Gil.

Phase: 2.

Finance asks Operations for the weekly sales report every Monday.

## Objective and Deliverable
A CSV export of the weekly sales report.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: **Weekly export** (Happy path) — A user requests the weekly sales report export. Expected: a CSV file with the weekly sales report is produced.

## References, Risks and Dependencies
Open question (Laura Peña): which columns does Finance need?

## Completion Checklist
- [ ] Deliverable completed.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria met.
- [ ] Required validation completed.
- [ ] Review and approval recorded.
- [ ] Documentation updated, if applicable.

## Completion Evidence
Pending — to be linked as it becomes available.
